verdicts.reason: A is unusable: the hero photo has shrunk to a thumbnail stuck in the bottom-left corner, the headline block is small and floats top-left, the yellow tick marks are strewn down the page, an empty frame outline sits in the middle, and most of the canvas is blank. B keeps the photo at a readable size and the headline legible, but the headline panel and photo sit side by side with no overlap, so the original layering is lost. The thin frame wraps only the empty lower half of the headline column, the tick marks and the yellow bar at the top edge float with no clear purpose, and there are large dead areas below both elements.
